# HIGAET

> Helen Institute of Gen AI Engineering & Technology — a global institute spanning AI education, international university pathways, and enterprise software engineering.

HIGAET bridges foundational research and industrial application across three integrated divisions: HIGAET Academy (AI engineering education and placements), HIGAET Global Education Hub (study abroad, visa, and scholarship services), and HIGAET Technologies (enterprise AI solutions and software engineering).

- [/](/): HIGAET homepage — overview of the three divisions and institutional mission.
